evidence.detail: Reviewed TradingPostListingPanel creates rs/s/t/f only when TradingPostPlugin has no cached image for the current reviewed TradingPostListing item id; no other class or purpose constructs this helper in the listing path.
rs/s/t/f stores exactly one TradingPostListing record and one TradingPostListingPanel, and uses only the listing's item-id getter to request the missing image.
Its loop asks reviewed TradingPostPlugin for the item image by listing item id; a missing image returns true to retry, while a resolved image terminates the loop.
The helper waits until the client is in its loaded state, increments an internal attempt counter, and stops after three attempts rather than owning any general image-cache lifecycle.

When an image resolves, the helper schedules one SwingUtilities.invokeLater callback that sets only the TradingPostListingPanel item-image JLabel to a new ImageIcon; it has no unrelated UI or network behavior.

proposals.note: TradingPostListingImageLoader is fixed by exclusive TradingPostListingPanel construction, reviewed TradingPostListing item-id input, reviewed TradingPostPlugin image lookup, bounded retry behavior and one Swing icon sink. Confidence is 0.999.
